attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The new script/CSS use hardcoded IDs (#color, #color_wrapper, #color_opacity) instead of field-specific ones, so any content type with multiple TextField-Color fields on one form will break (only the first field's picker/opacity will work), and the value format now can include an 8-digit hex alpha suffix that downstream consumers expecting plain 6-digit hex colors may mishandle."}

reason: The new script/CSS use hardcoded IDs (#color, #color_wrapper, #color_opacity) instead of field-specific ones, so any content type with multiple TextField-Color fields on one form will break (only the first field's picker/opacity will work), and the value format now can include an 8-digit hex alpha suffix that downstream consumers expecting plain 6-digit hex colors may mishandle.
